claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet at the 98th Academy Awards.
Rose Byrne was a Best Actress nominee for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You at the 98th Academy Awards.
Kate Hudson was a Best Actress nominee for Song Sung Blue at the 98th Academy Awards.
Renate Reinsve was a Best Actress nominee for Sentimental Value at the 98th Academy Awards.
Emma Stone was a Best Actress nominee for Bugonia at the 98th Academy Awards
